# Checklist

<!-- Remove items that do not apply. For completed items, change [ ] to [x]. -->

- [ ] Python: `uv run pytest` passes in `python/`
- [ ] TypeScript: `pnpm test` passes in `typescript/`
- [ ] tests are included for new or changed behavior
- [ ] the change is made in every language it concerns, so they behave the same
- [ ] `pre-commit run --all-files` passes
- [ ] documentation (README, docstrings, examples) is changed or added
